svg.aria-label: A terminal watching a Laravel app grow from laravel new: documents in the default folders, an Actions folder, an Agents module, the knowledge code moving into its own module, then a versioned API in src beside app, more modules and app layers as the app grows, then a timelapse of ever more modules, layers and API versions until the tree overflows the terminal, before it all collapses into a single index.php and starts again
